subject: how to avoid recompiling in RStan?

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: how to avoid recompiling in RStan?
parts:
I can't seem to get it to work consistently.

I use this:

> library(rstan);
> rstan_options(auto_write = TRUE);

and then this

> fit <- stan("bern.stan", data=list(y=y, N=N), save_dso = TRUE);

What happens is that if I quit out of R and restart,
it uses the saved model. But as long as I'm in the
same session, it doesn't.

I'm on the Mac on the latest version of RStan.

- Bob
